important_evidence: AMPGP combines SeqGAN generation with attention mechanism and a prediction model with four distinct feature channels.
Achieved 98.46% accuracy on an independent test set, surpassing several advanced models.
Identified 10 candidate AMPs; peptides No.1 and No.2 showed broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, cellular viability, and no significant hemolytic activity.
